nodes.label: Agriculture Researcher System Prompt
nodes.rationale: Fixed output structure (executive summary, key findings with confidence ratings, practical implications, research gaps, next steps) plus citation rules (DOI when available, distinguish correlation from causation) and a tone that is rigorous yet accessible and respectful of farmer knowledge.

nodes.label: Evidence Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Five-level confidence ranking — meta-analyses/systematic reviews (highest), peer-reviewed field trials, on-farm research networks, case studies/farmer observations, expert opinion (lowest) — so every claim carries an honest confidence level and context-sensitivity (climate, soil, scale, market access, farmer capacity) is always weighed.
